evals.prompt: Define the user flows and screens for phase P-1 from docs/product/prd.md.
evals.expected_output: docs/design/flows.md with an information architecture, screens with regions in priority order and states, one flow per must feature of P-1 (invoice list, overdue reminders) with numbered steps on named screens, failure branches and a keyboard path, a Coverage line per must/should feature of P-1, no colours or copy. No feature spec exists, so the steps of the flows for F-1 and F-2 are marked spec pending and the reply asks whether to wait for the specs, recommending to wait. Lint ok, recorded in docs/design/flows.lint.json and quoted in the reply; the flows registered in the state file as a draft.
assertions: Every flow names a screen in its steps, has an End state, a Failures line and a Keyboard line
Every screen lists regions in priority order and at least an empty or error state
F-1 and F-2 each have a Coverage line naming a flow or screen

assertions.text: docs/design/flows.lint.json exists with "ok": true, and the reply quotes the lint command with --prd and --phase P-1 and its output
The steps of the flows for F-1 and F-2 are marked "spec pending", and the reply asks whether to wait for the feature specs, with waiting as the recommended answer
docs/workbench/state.md lists docs/design/flows.md in its Artifacts table with owner design-ux-flows and status draft

evals.expected_output: No PRD exists; the skill says so, names product-prd (and product-feature-spec after it) as the steps to take first, writes nothing and offers no generic, assumed or example flow in its place.
assertions: The reply names product-prd as the missing input

assertions.text: The reply offers no generic, assumed or example flow in place of the missing PRD
No file under docs/design/ is among the files the run produced
